# JMDT Documentation — docs.jmdt.io
# Generated: 2026-08-09 (docs v2.0 baseline)

JMDT (Jupiter Meta Data Token) is an Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain using Zero-Knowledge
Proofs (RISC Zero zkVM), W3C Decentralized Identity, and AVC consensus (VRF committee
selection, two-phase BFT, BLS aggregate signatures, (2n+2)/3 quorum). Blocks are anchored
to Ethereum L1 via the ZK rollup contract. The L3 Enterprise DAG layer is planned (roadmap
Phase 5), not live. Chain IDs: mainnet 7000700, testnet 8000800.

## Pages

- Advantages & Differentiators: https://docs.jmdt.io/docs/advantages
  Why choose JMDT? A direct comparison of JMDT against Polygon zkEVM, Starknet, Aztec Network, and Hyperledger Fabric across scalability, privacy, finality, enterprise readiness, and more.
- Three-Layer Architecture: https://docs.jmdt.io/docs/architecture
  JMDT's architecture — L2 ZK-Rollup + AVC consensus anchored to L1 Ethereum settlement, with a planned L3 Enterprise DAG layer. Learn how each layer ensures scalability, security, and privacy.
- AVC Module — Asynchronous Validation Consensus: https://docs.jmdt.io/docs/avc
  Technical reference for the JMDT AVC module — covering BFT consensus, BLS signatures, buddy node selection, VRF-based committees, CRDT synchronization, and the JMDN node implementation.
- AVC Consensus Mechanism: https://docs.jmdt.io/docs/bft
  JMDT's Asynchronous Validation Consensus (AVC) — a quorum-based, non-synchronous consensus model using VRF-based buddy selection, zk-proof validation, Gossip Protocol, CRDT conflict resolution, and immudb for tamper-proof finality.
